src: BUILD_PLAN §3.12, §4.4 #7 (S-2). Every harvested route the rebuild changes, drops or locks, with a reason and a spec citation. The WorldBuild route-on-geometry check (src/worldgen/RouteCheck.luau; lune run tools/bake/check.luau) exempts exactly these routes; anything else off geometry fails CI.

lots.reason: Outer home keeps its v5.4 orientation and roof so its harvested ridge, downspout and gutter routes still sit on its greybox; its flat roof landing at the ridge height is kept flat (v5.4 roofY = peak) until the W3 house templates replace it.

patches.reason: addHouseGutters adds terrainHeight to an already absolute outer-home eave (cfg.h = base + height), so on raised lots the downspout top and the gutter-to-roof joint sit about one terrain height above the eave; the gutter-to-roof run also climbs a gable that the flat v5.4 landing does not have. Re-seat the top to the eave above local ground (Registry, W1 #8); until then the routes are exempt from the on-geometry check.
patches.cite: routes_movement verifier 3 and 4 (v5.4 L4298-4299, L2126, L2129)

patches.reason: Ridge-length quirk reproduced, not fixed: on the 9 rotated outer homes the ridge route runs z +/- 0.48 depth while the drawn ridge runs the width + 1.3, so the route is shorter than the ridge. Kept as harvested so saved positions and AI rail paths stay valid.

The garden wheelbarrow watch perch rides on the decorative wheelbarrow accent of the v3.5 garden plot, which is yard-prop kit content; the W1 greybox has no yard props, so the perch floats until the yard kits land.
patches.cite: wildlife_foraging §11 garden plots (v5.4 L12619-12650); BUILD_PLAN §3.4 backyards
